plain.li: I saw you two at supper, you know.
You and {ABOUT_nameDef}, then, finally.
About time somebody said it out loud.
You've been smiling at nothing all morning.
{ABOUT_nameDef} is lucky, and I'll tell them so.
I'm glad for you, I really am.
Be good to each other, that's all I ask.

warm.li: Nothing makes me happier than seeing you like this.

blunt.li: Everyone already knew, for the record.

cheerful.li: Wait until the rest of them hear about this.

gloomy.li: Hold on to it, good things don't come round often.

plain.li: Are you sure about {ABOUT_nameDef}?
I'll say it once and then I'll keep quiet.
You could have had anyone in this colony.
I only want what's best for you, you know that.
Don't expect me at their side of the table.
I hope I'm wrong about {ABOUT_nameDef}, for your sake.

warm.li: If you're happy, I'll try, but I'm worried.

cheerful.li: Well, nobody's perfect, least of all {ABOUT_nameDef}.

gloomy.li: This will end in tears, you watch.

cold.li: It's your life, do as you like.

plain.li: My child, getting married, I can hardly believe it.
You have my blessing, both of you.
I remember when you couldn't tie your own boots.
Your grandmother would have cried at this.
Come here, let me look at you properly.
We'll need a proper table for the wedding.

warm.li: I'm so proud of you I could burst.

cheerful.li: A wedding, finally, I'll start on the cake.

gloomy.li: Make the most of it, every single day.

plain.li: I heard about it, I'm sorry.
It took courage to ask, more than most have.
Sit with me a while, you don't have to talk.
It's not the end of anything, I promise.
Give it time, it'll hurt less than it does now.
You did nothing wrong by asking.

warm.li: Come on, I saved you some of the good tea.

cheerful.li: Chin up, you're still the best company in this colony.

gloomy.li: It happens to all of us, sooner or later.

plain.li: [glad] I've got something to tell you, and you should sit down.
[glad] We're going to have a child, you and me.
[glad] Put your hand here, there's someone new.
[glad] I wanted you to be the first to know.
[worried] I'm expecting, and I don't know what we do now.
[worried] We weren't ready for this, but it's coming anyway.
[worried] There's a child on the way, and I'm frightened.

warm.li: [glad] Our family is getting bigger, love.

blunt.li: [glad] I'm pregnant, it's yours, say something.
[worried] I'm pregnant, and no, we didn't plan it.

cheerful.li: [glad] Guess who's going to need a crib?

gloomy.li: [worried] A child, in all this, what were we thinking?

cold.li: [glad] I'm expecting, so we'd better plan for it.

plain.li: A grandchild, you're giving me a grandchild?
I'll start on something small and warm for them.
You were that small once, hard as that is to believe.
Whatever you need, you ask me first.
Me, a grandparent, I'm not old enough for this.
Your child will have the best of us, I'll see to it.

warm.li: This is the best news I've had in years.

blunt.li: Good, I was starting to think I'd never get one.

cheerful.li: I'm going to spoil them rotten, you can't stop me.

gloomy.li: I hope this world is kinder to them than it was to us.

cold.li: About time the family went on.

plain.li: To {OTHER_nameDef}, a year older and a head taller.
Happy birthday, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Look at you, all grown up.
I remember the day you were born like it was yesterday.
Make a wish, but don't tell anyone what it is.
Another year, and you're still the best of us.
Who let you get so big, I'd like to know.

warm.li: We're all so proud of you, {OTHER_nameDef}.

blunt.li: Older, taller, still won't eat your greens.

gloomy.li: They grow up so fast, every one of them.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are together. I wrote it down so it would be real.
I don't know how to say this except plainly: {OTHER_nameDef} feels the same.
[night] I can't sleep. {OTHER_nameDef} is all I can think about, and that's fine.
We told no one, and everyone seems to know already.

warm.li: Somewhere in all this hard work, {OTHER_nameDef} and I found each other.

gloomy.li: I'm happy, and I'm already afraid of losing it. {OTHER_nameDef} says that's normal.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I have come to an understanding. I find I'm pleased about it.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are going to be married. I keep saying it under my breath.
Engaged. To {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll need to write that a few more times before I believe it.
We're to be married, {OTHER_nameDef} and I. Now to find something to wear.
[night] I lay awake planning the wedding until I realised I was smiling in the dark.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked, or I asked, we can't agree. Either way, we're getting married.

gloomy.li: Engaged to {OTHER_nameDef}. Let the world try to take this one from me.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I will marry. It is the right decision.

plain.li: I asked {OTHER_nameDef} to marry me. The answer was no. I went for a long walk.
{OTHER_nameDef} said no. Kindly, which almost made it worse.
I don't want to write about today. I asked, and {OTHER_nameDef} said no.
[night] Can't sleep. Every time I close my eyes I'm asking {OTHER_nameDef} again.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} said no. I'll still be their friend, if they'll have that.

cheerful.li: Well, {OTHER_nameDef} said no. At least I can say I asked.

gloomy.li: I knew {OTHER_nameDef} would say no. I asked anyway. I'm a fool.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} declined my proposal. I will not ask again.

plain.li: [glad] I'm expecting. I keep putting a hand on my belly when nobody's looking.
[glad,partner] A child. I have to tell {OTHER_nameDef} properly, at the right moment.
[glad] There's someone new on the way. I've started making a list of names.
[worried] I'm expecting, and it's too soon. I don't know how we'll manage.
[worried,partner] A child is coming. We didn't plan for it. I have to tell {OTHER_nameDef}.
[worried] Pregnant. I sat on the edge of the bed for an hour before I could stand.

warm.li: [glad] A little one on the way. This colony is going to have to make room.

cheerful.li: [glad] I'm going to be a mother! I want to tell everyone and no one at once.

gloomy.li: [worried] A child, here, now. I'll have to be stronger than I am.

cold.li: [glad] I am expecting. There are preparations to make.

plain.li: We lost the child. I don't have anything else to write.
[partner] The baby is gone. {OTHER_nameDef} held my hand until it got dark.
I keep reaching for something that isn't there any more.
[night] It's quiet tonight. Too quiet. I keep listening for a heartbeat I'll never hear.

warm.li: We lost our child today. The others have been so kind that I can't stand it.

cheerful.li: I can't find anything good in today. Tomorrow, maybe.

gloomy.li: The child is gone before it ever saw the sky. I don't understand why.

cold.li: The pregnancy is over. I will not write more about it.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is {YEARS} today. We raised a glass at supper and {OTHER_pronoun} pretended not to like it.
{YEARS} years old, {OTHER_nameDef}. Where did the time go?
{OTHER_nameDef} turned {YEARS}. I measured {OTHER_objective} against the door frame again.
[night] {OTHER_nameDef} fell asleep still wearing the birthday grin. {YEARS} years old.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is {YEARS}, and every one of those years has been a gift.

cheerful.li: Happy birthday, {OTHER_nameDef}! {YEARS}! I sang badly and nobody minded.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is {YEARS}. Soon {OTHER_pronoun} won't need me at all.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has reached {YEARS} years. Growth is on schedule.
